tasks.title: Reconcile audit-log retention with legal
tasks.description: Eng spec says 365 days, legal wants 90. Pick one, update docs.

comments.body:
**Decision: 90-day retention for v2.4.**

Resolved with input from Priya (eng), Morgan (sales), Sam (design), and Dani (legal requirement).

- 90 days is low-lift (config change, not schema change) per Priya.
- Satisfies legal's requirement (≤90 days max).
- Is a compliance selling point for Morgan's three gated Q2 accounts (less data liability).
- Per-tenant configurability (e.g. enterprise customers wanting longer retention) is logged as a future backlog item — Priya will create that task.

Action: Updating eng spec and PRD to reflect 90-day retention. Moving this task to In Review.
